list.title: Connections
list.subtitle: Connect your company with General Contractors or Sub-contractors to share project events in real time.

invite.title: Invite Sub-contractor
invite.sub_id_hint: The sub-contractor must already have an account. Ask them for their Tenant ID from Settings.
invite.error_generic: Failed to send invitation. Please try again.
invite.error_exists: A connection with this tenant already exists.
invite.error_not_found: Tenant not found. Check the Tenant ID and try again.
invite.error_addon: Cross-tenant collaboration requires the add-on. Upgrade to Business, or add the Cross-Tenant Collaboration add-on to your Professional plan.
invite.lookup_not_found: No company found. Check the slug or email and try again.
invite.lookup_ambiguous: That email matches more than one company — use the company slug instead.
invite.scope_placeholder: e.g. Electrical rough-in and trim, floors 1–3
invite.upgrade_body: Connecting with other companies is included on Business and Enterprise plans, or available as an add-on for Professional. Upgrade to start collaborating.

detail.you_are_gc: You are the General Contractor in this connection.
detail.you_are_sub: You are the Sub-contractor in this connection.
detail.revoke_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to revoke this connection?
detail.decline_confirm_message: The General Contractor will be notified. They can send a new invitation later.
detail.revoked_readonly_note: This connection was revoked. The shared history stays readable for both parties, but no new updates will flow.
detail.project_limit_error: Accepting creates a linked project, but your plan's project limit is reached. Archive a project or upgrade, then accept again.
detail.completed_readonly_note: This connection is completed. The shared history below is a read-only archive — no new updates will flow.

events.title: Shared Events
events.subtitle: Events shared between both parties on this connection.
events.no_events: No events yet. Publish an event to share information with the other party.

rfi.title: Shared RFIs
rfi.subtitle: Requests for Information, change orders, and submittals shared across this connection.

sub_portal.title: Sub Portal Invitations
sub_portal.subtitle: Invite a subcontractor who has no account. They join free and can see only this project's schedule, documents, and RFIs directed to them.
sub_portal.error_generic: Failed to send invitation. Please try again.
sub_portal.error_exists: A user with this email already exists in your company.
sub_portal.error_limit: Your plan's user limit has been reached. Upgrade to add more.
sub_portal.no_members: No subcontractors invited to this project yet.

portal.title: Sub Portal
portal.no_projects: No projects have been shared with you yet.
portal.error_forbidden: You do not have access to this project.

accept.intro: Set a password to access your contractor portal.
accept.error_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
accept.error_invalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired.
accept.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
accept.missing_token: Missing invite token. Please use the link from your invitation email.

permissions.title: Sharing permissions
permissions.subtitle: Choose which event types flow across this connection. Core workflow events are always shared.
permissions.locked_on: Always shared — cannot be turned off.
permissions.proposed_note: Sharing more requires the other party's approval — proposal sent.
permissions.proposal_pending_mine: Your permission change is awaiting the other party's approval.
permissions.proposal_pending_theirs: The other party proposed a permission change that would share more data.
permissions.error: Could not update permissions. Please try again.

closeout.title: Closeout
closeout.subtitle: Check that shared items are resolved, then mark this connection completed.
closeout.open_change_orders: {{count}} shared change order(s) awaiting a decision
closeout.all_clear: All shared items are resolved — ready to complete.
closeout.ack_label: Complete anyway (I acknowledge the open items)
closeout.complete_confirm_message: The bridge becomes a read-only archive for both companies and the sub's linked project is marked completed.
closeout.incomplete_error: Open shared items remain — resolve them or check "complete anyway".

invoice.share_with_gc: Share with GC over the connection
invoice.share_hint: When submitted (status Sent), the GC sees this invoice on the connection and can approve and mark it paid.

lien_waiver.title: Lien waivers
lien_waiver.subtitle: The GC requests waivers; the Sub signs them. Open waivers block closeout.
lien_waiver.error: Could not complete the lien waiver action. Please try again.

field_activity.title: Field activity
field_activity.subtitle: Daily reports and labor summaries shared from the sub's field work.

discovery.settings_subtitle: Opt in to the contractor directory so general contractors can find your company by name, trade, and region. Only your company name, trades, and service region are ever shown — never your projects, people, or financials.
discovery.owner_only: Only the account owner can change the discovery profile.
discovery.optin_label: List my company in the contractor directory
discovery.optin_desc: Off by default. When enabled, general contractors on The Jobsite can find you and send a connection invite.
discovery.service_area_placeholder: e.g. Dane County and surrounding areas
discovery.error_load: Failed to load the discovery profile.
discovery.error_save: Could not save the discovery profile.
discovery.no_results: No matching companies found. Try the company ID or email lookup, or send a free Sub Portal invite instead.
